Dominated convergence applied to a Gaussian denominator window yields the exact leading reciprocal-tail constant, and tail integration gives the if-and-only-if q<1 moment spectrum. Endpoint substitution and a derivative sign argument establish the two exceptional laws and unique interior maximal coefficient. Exact-rational and numerical checks reproduce representative identities without substituting finite experiments for proofs.
